# The frames of the main flows this build writes, at the oldest peer version
# it works with (`OLDEST_PEER_PROTOCOL_VERSION` in src/lib.rs), one
# `name value` per line: postcard frames as hex, the lease claim as the JSON a
# workspace keeps, and each connection protocol a server is dialled on.
# tilo-peer-state's lease test reads the claim with today's types and fails on
# a byte that differs. What a version wrote never changes: a version bump that
# keeps the window writes the frames of the version it leaves here first, and
# a change the frames cannot pass sets them to its own, as the session
# transport's frames went with the transport
# (docs/architecture/compatibility.md, "Two versions at once").
version 72
alpn tilo-server-sibling/2
hello 
hello-ack
